videos.video_subject: Manchester City were found guilty of 114 of 115 Premier League charges, putting Erling Haaland's contract situation in doubt and fuelling links to Liverpool, Arsenal and Barcelona, while he scored three goals in three games for Norway in October 2026
videos.video_script: Manchester City just got found guilty on one hundred fourteen of one hundred fifteen Premier League charges. City are appealing, but the fallout could hit Erling Haaland directly. Reports say he might be able to rip up his contract, with Liverpool, Arsenal and Barcelona all circling. Meanwhile Haaland hasn't blinked. Three games for Norway, three goals. If City's punishment lands hard, this could be the transfer story of the season.
